---
title: grouping fitted values in plot() methods
embed-resources: true
---

```{r}
library(tidychangepoint)
plot(fit_meanshift_norm(CET, tau = 330), use_time_index = TRUE) 

plot(segment(CET, method = "pelt"), use_time_index = TRUE)

trend_wn <- CET |>
  segment(
    method = "ga", 
    model_fn = fit_meanshift_norm, 
    penalty_fn = BIC, 
    population = log_gabin_population(CET),
    popSize = 200, 
    maxiter = 50,
    run = 10
  )
plot(trend_wn, use_time_index = TRUE)
```
